title: AI/ML Senior Associate Scientist
description:
ROLE SUMMARYAs a core member of our AI/ML, Quantitative & Digital Sciences (AQDS) team, you will:

Design, implement, and maintain full-stack applications that integrate advanced Machine Learning (ML) techniques with internal and external data sources.
Develop and apply generative AI techniques using large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of essential clinical trial documents.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop scalable, cloud-native microservices and APIs for AI/ML tools aimed at optimizing patient recruitment, site selection, and clinical trial management, incorporating generative AI capabilities to streamline authoring workflows.
Leverage modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue) to build intuitive user interfaces that provide real-time insights from ML models and facilitate decision-making for clinical operations, including AI-generated document review and customization.
Work closely with DevOps and data engineering teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure as code (IaC), and ensure secure deployment of AI/ML models, including generative AI systems, across cloud environments (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Implement AI/ML models in full-stack systems, ensuring robust backend processing and efficient front-end data visualization.
Engage with both internal and external stakeholders to continuously bring the latest advancements in generative AI, full-stack development, and AI/ML technologies to Pfizer, contributing to thought leadership through publications and presentations.





ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner with key therapy areas (e.g., Immunology & Inflammation, Oncology, Internal Medicine) to identify scientific and technical challenges, define data pipelines, and implement full-stack solutions that leverage AI/ML methods, including generative AI models, to generate actionable insights and automate clinical trial documentation.
Translate complex clinical data and analytics requirements into full-stack digital products, ensuring that development priorities align with the overall clinical development goals.
Lead the end-to-end development of full-stack applications, from database schema design and API development to front-end user interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with AI/ML workflows and LLM-powered document generation systems.
Supervise and guide the deployment of robust back-end services that support predictive and classification algorithms, as well as generative AI models, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
Develop and maintain dashboards and data visualization tools that provide clinical and operational teams with real-time analytics and insights driven by advanced ML models, while integrating tools for generating and reviewing AI-authored clinical trial documents.
Maintain an active external network in the AI/ML, generative AI, and full-stack development communities, continuously monitoring state-of-the-art capabilities and evaluating their potential impact on Pfizer's development teams.





QUALIFICATIONSBasic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in full-stack development in the pharma, biotech, or tech industry.
Proficient in full-stack development, including back-end technologies (Node.js, Django, Flask) and front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
Strong understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL) and experience in designing RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
Experience with AI/ML model integration, including developing APIs to interface with ML models and building front-end components for real-time data visualization.
Experience working with large language models (LLMs) for generative AI applications.
Strong programming skills (Python, JavaScript, R) and familiarity with cloud technologies (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure).
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Computational Biology, Engineering).
Hands-on experience with the full-stack development of clinical trial management systems, focusing on integrating AI/ML-driven insights into clinical workflows, and automating document generation through LLMs.
Proven experience leading end-to-end clinicaldevelopment projects, particularly in Phases 2 and 3, from study design to regulatory submission.
Experience with data engineering workflows, including ETL processes, data lakes, and scalable data architectures.
Prior experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones is a plus.





Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
 
To apply please visit our website www.pfizercareers.com and search job AI/ML Senior Associate Scientist, id 4919208.
Please apply by sending your CV and a motivational letter in English

Web Development: Create responsive and visually appealing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
JavaScript Webapp Frameworks: Proficiency in both Angular and React is essential. You'll leverage these frameworks to build dynamic and interactive user interfaces.
API Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend components.
Testing and Optimization: Implement unit tests, end-to-end tests, and performance optimizations to enhance application reliability and speed.
User-Centric Approach: Understand user needs and translate them into intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing designs.
Collaboration with Designers: Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to create consistent and delightful user experiences.
Responsive Design: Ensure applications are designed to work seamlessly across various devices and screen sizes.
Enforce coding standards, best practices, and thorough testing (unit, integration, etc.) to ensure reliability and maintainability.
Set a vision, prioritize workstreams, and provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and mentorship for a global team with technical & functional expertise.
Coach direct reports to adopt best practices, improve technical skills, develop an innovative mindset, and achieve professional growth through technical and organizational thought leadership.

Qualifications
Must-Have

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or engineering related area.
10+ years of work experience as a frontend developer, with a track record of leading successful projects and software that is deployed as building and deploying Web Applications.
2-3 years of hands-on experience leading software engineering teams
Track record of managing stakeholder groups and effecting change
Recognized by peers as an expert in software, with deep expertise in frontend solution architecture, and hands-on development
Expert knowledge of frontend technologies; familiar with Angular, React,HTML/CSS/Bootstrap​.
Deep understanding of digital accessibility and disability inclusion. Experience developing digital products that comply with accessibility standards.
Familiarity with fundamental data science principles. Understanding concepts like data preprocessing, feature engineering, and statistical analysis is essential.
Adept at creating compelling visualizations. Familiarity with tools like Tableau, Power BI, and similar data visualization libraries.
Understands how to synthesize facts and information from varied data sources, both new and pre-existing, into clear insights and perspectives that can be understood by business stakeholders
Clearly articulates expectations, capabilities, and action plans; actively listens with others' frame of reference in mind; appropriately shares information with team; favorably influences people without direct authority
Clearly articulates scope and deliverables of projects; breaks complex initiatives into detailed component parts and sequences actions appropriately; develops action plans and monitors progress independently; designs success criteria and uses them to track outcomes; engages with stakeholders throughout to ensure buy-in
Ability to manage projects from end-to-end, from requirements gathering through implementation, and development of support processes
Demonstrated experience interfacing with internal and external teams to develop innovative frontend solutions

Highly self-motivated to deliver both independently and with strong team collaboration

Computer literate.

About the role
Responsible for maintenance and proper functionality of electrical systems and devices. Daily on-site inspections, interventions and reporting. Ensuring that safety measures are followed.

Daily on site inspecting of electrical systems, filling of check lists and acting per instructions of direct superiors.
Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components to locate the cause of a breakdown and perform reparation/replacement on faulty elements, utilizing hand and power tools.

To respond promptly and accurately on maintenance request and work orders.
Timely and accurately reporting to superiors and relevant parties about completed and uncompleted tasks.

Lights checking and bulbs replacement.

Responsible for cleanliness and organization of electrical rooms and workshop.
Monitoring of electricity consumption and report immediately if any deviation is noted.
Searching for potential improvements in order to reduce consumption and improve work quality.
To follow up room maintenance as per Perfect Room Program
To attend department meetings.
To follow up spare parts stock and to inform superior timely when refilling is needed.
To liaise, actively support and assist to the other technicians on any issue.
To be familiar with the buildings BoH and public areas, all pieces of equipment and installation (electrical cabinets, cable routing, control panels, BMS, room management system, Lutron, Access control, CCTV, FLS systems, electricity meters and other electrical devices…).
To be familiar with main shut ’offs (water, electricity, heating and cooling, LPG) and to react quickly in a case of emergency.
To be familiar with FLS systems and procedures.
To participate actively in handover process of new buildings
Any and all other duties as assigned by superiors.

Strong technical knowledge.
Proven experience as an electrician in commercial and/or industrial electrical systems.
Proven success working in a team.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals.
Excellent problem-solving ability.
Good spoken and written English.
Computer literate.
